messages.subject: Identical CNVs residing in different chromosomes
messages.subject_clean: Identical CNVs residing in different chromosomes
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

My previous question has been resolved and I have run CODEX2 successfully. However my results include some CNVs that are identical in their CNV type, starting and ending base pair/exon and length. They only differ by their chromosome which seems unlikely! Has anyone encountered this before? Any help would be appreciated.

Many thanks,

Thomas Jones

messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] Duplicated CNVs response
messages.body_plain:
Yes, it’s better to run each chromosome separately / in parallel. There’s an optional chr argument for CODEX2 I believe.

What I meant is to check in your input bed file whether the coordinates correspond to any row entries. But I am glad you solved this issue.

Yuchao
